findings.highlight: An unknown, imaginary stance for an unknown, imaginary man.
findings.evidenceJa: 構えらしき物を持たぬアサシンの唯一の構え。
findings.governingReading: This is Assassin's sole stance, exceptional because he ordinarily has nothing resembling a fixed stance.
findings.explanation: The one stance used by a swordsman who normally has none becomes an “imaginary stance.” The change removes what makes this preparation exceptional before Swallow Reversal.

findings.highlight: his fatal technique that cuts his enemy
findings.evidenceJa: 敵を四散させる必殺剣。
findings.governingReading: The simultaneous blades following different circles form a killing sword that scatters the enemy's body into pieces.
findings.explanation: A fatal sword that tears the enemy apart becomes a technique that merely cuts.

findings.highlight: the other two attacks will hit even if one is blocked.
findings.evidenceJa: 一つの軌跡を受けた瞬間に二つの軌跡が体を四散させる。
findings.governingReading: Once someone enters range, the instant one trajectory is received, the other two tear the body apart.
findings.explanation: The other two trajectories dismembering the body becomes their merely hitting.

findings.highlight: the long katana will be able to make contact if the target tries to retreat back.
findings.evidenceJa: 長刀は苦もなく逃げる胴を薙ぐだろう。
findings.governingReading: Retreat offers no escape because the long sword will sweep through the fleeing torso without difficulty.
findings.explanation: The long blade effortlessly mowing down a retreating torso becomes being able to make contact.

findings.highlight: its precision and speed are astonishing.
findings.evidenceJa: その鋭利さ、迅速さに感嘆し、絶望する。
findings.governingReading: Although seeing it for the second time, she both marvels at and despairs before its keenness and speed.
findings.explanation: Saber despairing at the technique's sharpness and speed becomes simple astonishment.

findings.highlight: This magical sword is man's attempt at challenging the gods and Buddha.
findings.evidenceJa: この魔剣は、人の身で神仏に挑む修羅の業。
findings.governingReading: The sword is the terrible art or karma of an asura: a feat that challenges gods and Buddhas while performed in mortal flesh.
findings.explanation: An asura's art challenging gods and Buddhas in a human body becomes man's attempt to challenge them.

findings.highlight: She must have seen that the slightest gap was the magical sword's blind spot.
findings.evidenceJa: その、僅かばかりの隙間こそが、魔剣の死角だと彼女は見抜いたのか。
findings.governingReading: The narrator asks whether she perceived that tiny opening as the magical sword's blind spot; the precise cognition remains uncertain.
findings.explanation: The narration's question about whether Saber discerned the blind spot becomes a confident conclusion.

findings.highlight: She felt her body would be cut in four
findings.evidenceJa: 体を四つに断ち切られたと実感した。
findings.governingReading: At the instant she threw herself into the opening, she had the bodily conviction that she was cut into four; the next lines explain why she survived intact.
findings.explanation: Saber's felt experience that her body had been cut into four becomes a prediction that it would be cut.

findings.highlight: Saber draws her sword and runs up the stairs with all her might.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは剣を引き抜き、全速で階段を駆け上がっていく。
findings.governingReading: After Assassin tells her to go, Saber pulls the sword back out of his pierced body and runs up the steps.
findings.explanation: Saber pulling her embedded sword out of Assassin becomes drawing her sword.

findings.highlight: I suppose I require more training in that front as well.
findings.evidenceJa: どちらも修行不足という事か
findings.governingReading: Assassin ruefully jokes that both his swordsmanship and his judgment of women need further training.
findings.explanation: “In that front” should be “on that front.” The joke about needing training in both swordsmanship and judging women remains understandable.
